# SketchUp reader dependencies

These are unmodified published JavaScript files, embedded by `src/interchange.rs`
and used in a private module scope. Browser KetchUp runs them in a dedicated Web
Worker. Desktop KetchUp uses the equivalent compiled C++ reader described below
on the file-operation thread. No npm install, bundler, external service, SketchUp
SDK, or Python/Node installation is needed at runtime.

- OpenSKP **1.3.0**: npm `openskp`, `dist/index.js` → `openskp.cjs`, MIT.
  https://github.com/iamahsanmehmood/openskp
- fflate **0.8.3**: npm `fflate`, `lib/browser.cjs` → `fflate.cjs`, MIT.
  https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
- earcut **3.2.4**: npm `earcut`, `dist/earcut.dev.js` → `earcut.cjs`, ISC.
  https://github.com/mapbox/earcut
- FlatBuffers **25.9.23**: npm `flatbuffers`, `js/flatbuffers.min.js` →
  `flatbuffers.js`, Apache-2.0. https://github.com/google/flatbuffers

The adjacent LICENSE files must accompany redistribution. The adapter is
KetchUp code. The reader supports legacy MFC and modern ZIP/VFF SKP containers.
Textures, scenes, annotations, and linked component definitions are not imported;
component placements become independent editable groups. Texture material base
colors are retained. Malformed or unsupported models fail before the document
is changed.

## Native reader

`native/` contains the parsing/model/JSON source subset and public headers from
OpenSKP commit `23a15e8742e936694bf14aa029cb0e2862dce5b9` (MIT, see
`LICENSE-openskp`). Unused exporters are not compiled. `include/openskp/export.hpp`
is the static-library export shim normally generated by upstream CMake.

`native/miniz/` contains miniz source from commit
`77d0dce8627735138c51770d1799a1ef48f2117d`, pinned by upstream's CMake file;
its MIT license is in `native/miniz/LICENSE`. `miniz_export.h` is its static
export shim. Cargo's `cc` build dependency compiles these local sources without
network access. A C/C++17 compiler is required for native development. Browser
builds bypass native compilation entirely. KetchUp's C ABI and topology adapter
are in `src/skp_native.cpp`; no interpreter or JavaScript engine is linked on
desktop.
